full_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single square transparent-background research icon for a real-time strategy game, readable at 32 pixels. Primary request: Bronze breastplate displayed between two small round shields. Subject details: Bronze cuirass in center, matched small round bronze shields at left and right; heroic silhouette with legible plate shape.. Style/medium: original low-poly toon 3D render, chunky monumental forms and clear ancient-world materials, dramatic sculptural silhouette. Composition: one centered object group, large shapes, close icon framing, no pedestal, no border. Lighting: warm upper-left key light with cool soft shadows. Color treatment: rich but restrained bronze, stone, cloth and earth tones, strong value separation. Background: genuinely transparent. Constraints: no text, letters, numerals, labels, watermark, UI, extra figures, tiny clutter or cropped key shapes.
